 REQUEST FOR CORRECTION TO SOAH ORDER NO. 30 AND UPDATED NOTICE
          OF REPRESENTATION ON BEHALF OF INTERVENORS
              THOMAS CRAWFORD AND MATT MATHAIS


       TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:

       COMES NOW, Gregory Klipp, attorney for Matt Mathias, Manager of SF Eastside

Investments, LLC ("SF Eastside"), and Thomas Crawford, Partner of Crawford Partners, LP

("Crawford Partners"), intervenors in the above-captioned proceeding (collectively, the

"Intervenors"), and files this Request for Correction to SOAH Order No. 30 and Updated Notice

of Representation, and in support thereof respectfully states as follows:

                                    I.      BACKGROUND

       By SOAH Order No. 17, Matt Mathias and Thomas Crawford were granted intervenor

status in this proceeding. On May 13, 2026, prior to the issuance of SOAH Order No. 30,

Intervenors filed their respective Statements of Position and Direct Testimony. Specifically: SF


                                            Page 1 of 4
 Eastside Investments, LLC filed its Statement of Position and Direct Testimony at Interchange

Item No. 4378 in opposition to Segment Link U1; and Crawford Partners, LP filed its Statement

of Position and Direct Testimony at Interchange Item No. 4408 in opposition to Segment Link

U1.

         In each of the foregoing filings, Gregory Klipp and The Jones Law Firm PC were

identified as counsel of record for the Intervenors. Notwithstanding the prior designation of

counsel and the representations made in the May 13, 2026 filings, Schedule B to SOAH Order

No. 30 contains the following clerical errors:

         A. Thomas Crawford / Crawford Partners, LP

             -   Fails to identify Gregory Klipp and The Jones Law Firm PC as counsel of record;

                 and

             -   Incorrectly identifies Crawford Partners, LP as opposing Segment Link P1 rather

                 than Segment Link U1.

         B. Matt Mathias / SF Eastside Investments, LLC

             -   Fails to list Matt Mathias, Manager of SF Eastside Investments, LLC, as a party to

                 this proceeding;

             -   Fails to identify Gregory Klipp and The Jones Law Firm PC as counsel of record;

                 and

             -   Fails to identify Matt Mathias, as Manager of SF Eastside Investments, LLC, as

                 an intervenor opposed to Segment Link U1.

                               II.     REQUEST FOR CORRECTION

      Accordingly, Intervenors respectfully request that the official record and Schedule B to

SOAH Order No. 30 be corrected as follows:


                                             Page 2 of 4
        A. Thomas Crawford / Crawford Partners, LP

       1.     The record should reflect that Thomas Crawford, Partner of Crawford Partners, LP,

              is represented by Gregory Klipp of The Jones Law Firm PC, and that all

              communications and service related to Thomas Crawford or Crawford Partners, LP

              should be directed to counsel at the address provided in the signature block below.

       2.     The record should further reflect that, as set forth in Crawford Partners, LP's Direct

              Testimony and Statement of Position filed on May 13, 2026 (Interchange Item No.

              4408), Crawford Partners, LP is an intervenor opposed to Segment Link U1.

       B. Matt Mathias / SF Eastside Investments, LLC

       1.     The record should reflect that Matt Mathias, in his capacity as Manager of SF

              Eastside Investments, LLC, is a party to this proceeding consistent with SOAH

              Order No. 17.

       2.     The record should further reflect that Matt Mathias and SF Eastside Investments,

              LLC are represented by Gregory Klipp of The Jones Law Firm PC, and that all

              communications and service should be directed to counsel at the address provided

              in the signature block below.

       3.     The record should further reflect that, as set forth in SF Eastside Investments, LLC's

              Direct Testimony and Statement of Position filed on May 13, 2026 (Interchange

              Item No. 4378), SF Eastside Investments, LLC is an intervenor opposed to Segment

              Link U1.

       WHEREFORE, PREMISES CONSIDERED, Intervenors respectfully request that the

Administrative Law Judges correct Schedule B to SOAH Order No. 30 and the official record in


                                           Page 3 of 4
 accordance with the foregoing, and for such other and further relief to which Intervenors may be

justly entitled.



        Date: June 5, 2026

                                                     Respectfully submitted on behalf of Thomas
                                                     Crawford, Partner for Crawford Partners LP,
                                                     and Matt Mathais, Manager of SF Eastside
                                                     Investments, LLC
